fen_walk_spine.accept_text: The spine road, north from this pier through Bloodmoon and over the ridge to the manor gate. The whole length.

fen_wretches.turn_in_text: I knew four of them. I'm sorry for all of them.
fen_wretches.accept_text: The waterlogged wretches, on the beach at the Drowned Docks, and the shingle west of the jetty.

fen_noble_signets.turn_in_text: Houses, four names. The Rear Guard will want these.
